# google_design_center_application_template

Application template in Application Design Center.


To get more information about ApplicationTemplate, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/application-design-center/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.spaces.applicationTemplates)

## Example Usage - Designcenter Application Template Basic


```hcl
resource "google_design_center_application_template" "example" {
  project                 = "my-project-name"
  location                = "us-central1"
  space                   = "example-space"
  application_template_id = "example-template"
}
```

## Example Usage - Designcenter Application Template Full


```hcl
resource "google_design_center_application_template" "example" {
  project                 = "my-project-name"
  location                = "us-central1"
  space                   = "example-space"
  application_template_id = "example-full-template"
  display_name            = "Example Application Template"
  description             = "Managed by Terraform"
  composition_type        = "COMPOSITE"

  application_parameters {
    key   = "project_id"
    value = jsonencode("my-project-name")
  }

  application_parameters {
    key   = "region"
    value = jsonencode("us-central1")
  }

  saas_runtime_context {
    saas_names = [
      "projects/my-project-name/locations/us-central1/saas/example-saas",
    ]
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the application template.

* `space` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the space for the application template.

* `application_template_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the application template.


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  User-defined display name.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  User-defined description.

* `application_parameters` -
  (Optional)
  Parameters to apply to all components in an application, such as the
  project ID and region.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_application_parameters).

* `composition_type` -
  (Optional)
  Composition type of the template. Possible values include `STANDARD` and
  `COMPOSITE`. See the [REST API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/application-design-center/docs/reference/rest/Shared.Types/ApplicationCompositionType)
  for all supported values.

* `root_input_variables` -
  (Optional)
  Root level input variables of the application template. For `STANDARD`
  templates with `inputs_as_root_module_variables` enabled, the API
  populates these automatically from the components.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_root_input_variables).

* `root_output_variables` -
  (Optional)
  Root level output variables of the application template. For `STANDARD`
  templates with `inputs_as_root_module_variables` enabled, the API
  populates these automatically from the components.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_root_output_variables).

* `saas_runtime_context` -
  (Optional)
  SaaS runtime context for the application template.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_saas_runtime_context).

* `inputs_as_root_module_variables` -
  (Optional)
  Whether to expose all component input variables as root-level Terraform
  module variables. Only supported for `STANDARD` composition type
  templates.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_application_parameters"></a>The `application_parameters` block supports:

* `key` -
  (Required)
  The key of the parameter.

* `value` -
  (Optional)
  The value of the parameter, as a JSON-encoded string. Use
  `jsonencode()` to set it.

<a name="nested_root_input_variables"></a>The `root_input_variables` block supports:

* `variable` -
  (Required)
  The name of the variable.

* `component_uri` -
  (Required)
  The URI of the component that the variable belongs to.

<a name="nested_root_output_variables"></a>The `root_output_variables` block supports:

* `variable` -
  (Required)
  The name of the variable.

* `component_uri` -
  (Required)
  The URI of the component that the variable belongs to.

<a name="nested_saas_runtime_context"></a>The `saas_runtime_context` block supports:

* `saas_names` -
  (Required)
  The SaaS names, in the format
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/saas/{saas}`.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the application template.
  Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/spaces/{space}/applicationTemplates/{application_template}`

* `iac_format` -
  IaC format of the application template.

* `latest_revision` -
  Latest revision of the application template.

* `create_time` -
  The time the application template was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time the application template was last updated.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


ApplicationTemplate can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import ApplicationTemplate using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    space = "<-required value->"
    application_template_id = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_design_center_application_template.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import ApplicationTemplate using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template_id}}"
  to = google_design_center_application_template.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), ApplicationTemplate can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_design_center_application_template.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_application_template.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_application_template.default {{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template_id}}
```
